answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 152175 Country: India Title: Can Sunni Muslim boy marry a Mahdavi girl? Is it permissible? Question: Can Sunni Muslim boy marry a Mahdavi girl? Is it permissible? Answer ID: 152175 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1041/1015/B=10/1438) The beliefs of Mahdavi sect which are available in their books make them out of the fold of Islam. Thus the nikah of a Sunni boy is not valid with a Mahdavi girl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
